resources.string: ExpiryWatch is free, has no ads, and every feature will stay free. That\'s a promise.
If it helps you waste a little less and you\'d like to say thanks, you\'re welcome to buy me a coffee. It\'s entirely optional, and I truly appreciate your generosity.
You can always find this at the bottom of Settings.
Your generosity means a lot, and it helps keep ExpiryWatch free for everyone.
